title: IIBF IE&IFS Unit 17: Regulatory Hierarchy (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, IFSCA & FSDC)
summary: Exhaustive breakdown of apex regulatory statutory acts, mandates, supervisory perimeters (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, IFSCA), and the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC).

blocks.title: IIBF Core Foundation: Apex Regulatory Jurisdiction
blocks.summary: The Indian financial sector operates under sector-specific statutory regulators, coordinated at the apex level by the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC) chaired by the Union Finance Minister.

blocks.caption: Apex Financial Regulators in India
rows: Established **1 April 1935** (Hilton Young Commission); Nationalized **1 Jan 1949**; HQ: **Mumbai**
Commercial Banks, RRBs, UCBs, NBFCs, HFCs, Payment System Operators (NPCI), Primary Dealers, Money & Forex Markets.
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
Stock Exchanges (BSE, NSE), Depositories (NSDL, CDSL), Mutual Funds, Merchant Bankers, Stock Brokers, Credit Rating Agencies, AIFs, REITs/InvITs.
Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
Life Insurance, General Insurance, Health Insurance, Reinsurers (GIC Re), Insurance Web Aggregators, Corporate Agents.
Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
National Pension System (NPS), Atal Pension Yojana (APY), Pension Fund Managers, Central Recordkeeping Agencies (CRAs).
**Unified regulator for all financial services, products, and institutions in IFSCs** (combining powers of RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA in GIFT City).

**Chairperson: Union Finance Minister**. Members: RBI Governor, SEBI/IRDAI/PFRDA/IFSCA Chairpersons, Finance Secretary, Chief Economic Adviser. Handles inter-regulatory coordination & systemic stability.

blocks.content:
🎯 Top IIBF Traps for Unit 17:
1. **FSDC Chairperson:** The **Union Finance Minister** (NOT the RBI Governor) chairs the FSDC. The FSDC Sub-Committee is chaired by the **RBI Governor**.
2. **IRDAI Headquarters:** Located in **Hyderabad** (NOT Mumbai or New Delhi).
3. **IFSCA Role:** Acts as a **single unified regulator** in GIFT City, superseding RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, and PFRDA powers inside the IFSC jurisdiction.
